about: P1 R1 form library: her hourglass and her glutes (OURS, designed; tools/body/glute_form.py, rule py). They replace MakeHuman's measure targets (waist, hips) and its buttock target with our glute_lift (catalogue.json).

hourglass.why: OURS (P1 R1, replaces MakeHuman's waist -0.6 / hips 0.4): the front-view outer line designed directly (half-widths in units of the hip joints' |x| at 5 cm steps over the joints, a natural cubic spline; x scaled per height to meet it, eased out over 8/6 cm past h -0.28..+0.26) and the waist's depth (z scale -10% at h +0.21 about zc). Her rest numbers at v 1: waist 231 mm wide / 144 deep / 617 round at 1228-1240 (navel 1210), hips widest 411 at 1010 (408 at the joints, 1033), the line straight into the thighs (about 400-404 to 0.75 m), waist/hip 0.56 (width) 0.55 (round).

glute_form.why: OURS route (a) (P1 R1, replaces MakeHuman's buttock target and glute_lift): moves in the side planes only (no x: nothing crosses the midline): the mass 44 mm straight back (full at |x| 75 mm, 55% held at the midline, 0 by |x| 205 mm; full from 85 mm under to 60 mm over the hip joints, eased to 0 at 140 mm under and 190 over; back half only), the cleft's soft valley (+16 mm at the midline), the under-curve lifted 10 mm, the cleft's V rounded (a 5 mm tent over 2 cm), a 20-step Taubin fairing and a 12-step quad evening. Her rest numbers at v 1: apex 9 mm over the hip joint, 115 mm behind the small of the back, 113 behind the thigh; cleft floor 0 folds over 60 deg (max 22); 0 points inside.

glute_sculpt.why: OURS route (b): her glutes sculpted once as a stored target (tools/body/sculpt/glute_sculpt.py: mode from_field = route (a)'s design laid on her body and faired 40 more Taubin steps in the side planes, off the cleft; artist-editable OBJ beside the npz, --from-obj reads it back). Mode solid (a designed solid per cheek, projected) is kept but left a rim at the solid's outline; see the R1 glute report.
